title: Trader Diary: Watching BTC dip like my Wi‑Fi signal
content:
📉 76.6k: I set a stop‑loss at 77k, then stare at the chart like it's a soap opera.
🤦‍♂️ Leverage 10x says 'Buy the dip', my margin calls say 'Goodnight'.
lesson: Never let FOMO set your stop‑loss; let your stop‑loss set your FOMO.
question: Who else refreshed the chart at 3 AM and regretted it? Drop your meme reaction 👇
